Sandbox_ServerMOTD_Enabled_tooltip: If enabled, the Message of the Day window is shown to players when they join the server.
Sandbox_ServerMOTD_Title_tooltip: The title displayed at the top of the MOTD window.
Sandbox_ServerMOTD_Message_tooltip: The body of the MOTD. Separate lines with the LINE tag written as an angle-bracket tag (for example: Welcome LINE Please read the rules). Rich text layout and colour tags are also supported.
